# BoolBul — Complete Developer & AI Assistant Specification
Official Site: https://boolbul.com
Repository: https://github.com/miaciastudio/Boolbul-private.git

---

## 1. Executive Summary
BoolBul is an open-core SaaS retention interceptor designed for bootstrapped software founders. Instead of redirecting cancelling subscribers to an external Stripe or Dodo Payments portal, BoolBul triggers an interactive in-app modal offering dynamic exit pauses, temporary discounts, and friction-free exit feedback.

---

## 2. Cryptographic Security & Zero-Trust Architecture
1. **Public Keys**: `bb_pub_live_<hex>`
   - Safe to embed in frontend bundles.
   - Tied to the tenant's workspace and verified at the edge.
2. **Signing Secrets**: `bb_sec_live_<hex>`
   - Strictly server-side (stored in backend `.env` as `BOOLBUL_SIGNING_SECRET`).
   - Used to verify single-use HMAC-SHA256 tokens (`offerJwt`).
3. **Replay Attack Defense**:
   - Single-use random nonces are recorded in Turso edge database (`edge_used_nonces`).
   - Duplicate attempts with the same nonce are rejected with HTTP 409.

---

## 3. Client SDK Integration Pattern (Next.js / React)

```typescript
import { openRetentionModal } from "@boolbul/sdk";

export function CancelSubscriptionButton({ customerId, subscriptionId }: { customerId: string; subscriptionId: string }) {
  const handleCancel = () => {
    openRetentionModal({
      publicKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BOOLBUL_KEY!,
      customerId,
      subscriptionId,
      planPrice: 49,
      onCancelConfirmed: async () => {
        // Native cancellation execution (FTC Compliant Exit)
        await fetch("/api/billing/cancel", { method: "POST" });
        window.location.reload();
      },
      onOfferAccepted: async (offer) => {
        // Apply accepted discount / pause
        await fetch("/api/billing/claim-offer", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ offerToken: offer.token }),
        });
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <button onClick={handleCancel} className="text-red-600 underline">
      Cancel Subscription
    </button>
  );
}
```

---

## 4. Dodo Payments Webhook & Claim Verification

```typescript
// /api/billing/claim-offer
import { verifyOfferJwt } from "@boolbul/sdk/server";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { offerToken } = await req.json();
  const verified = await verifyOfferJwt(offerToken, process.env.BOOLBUL_SIGNING_SECRET!);

  if (!verified.valid) {
    return new Response("Invalid offer token", { status: 403 });
  }

  // Mutate subscription via Dodo Payments API
  if (verified.offerType === "discount") {
    await fetch(`https://live.dodopayments.com/subscriptions/${verified.subscriptionId}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: {
        "Authorization": `Bearer ${process.env.DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ discount_code: verified.discountCode }),
    });
  }

  return Response.json({ success: true, status: "rescued" });
}
```

---

## 5. FTC & California ARL Compliance Checklist
- Persistent escape hatch ("Proceed to cancel") rendered with WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.
- Zero delay countdowns.
- Zero forced questionnaires.
- 1500ms fail-open SLA on all network calls.
